title: Gradle, modules and the Kotlin toolchain

videos.script: Since lesson fourteen, Gradle has built the planner, and this course has mostly asked you to trust it. This lesson reads what it does. {{wrapper}} The wrapper, the small script that pins one exact Gradle version inside the project, and the two Kotlin versions its output names. {{script}} A build script read top to bottom, the configurations that decide where a dependency is visible, and the report that shows what a dependency brought with it. {{toolchain}} The toolchain, and the number it writes into every class file. {{catalog}} A version catalog, one file for every version. {{modules}} A new build with two modules, core and app, and internal, which finally means something. {{ship}} And install dist, which turns the program into a directory somebody without Gradle can run.
